title: Asahi Kasei
summary: Japanese chemical group supplying battery separators, resins and healthcare products.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Asahi Kasei makes battery separators, specialty resins, electronic materials and healthcare products. Its separator business supplies lithium-ion cell makers with coated membranes that affect safety and cycle life. The company also has a semiconductor-materials and automotive interiors presence.

Technology Exposure

  • Battery separators
  • Engineering plastics and resins
  • Healthcare and electronic materials

What To Watch

  • Separator capacity and pricing
  • EV cell demand
  • Healthcare segment performance

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
